recentItems.title: BRUNO GUIMARAES SCREAMER & DAVID RAYA HEROICS | HIGHLIGHTS | Sunderland vs Arsenal (0-2) | PL
recentItems.description:
Enjoy the highlights of our crucial 2-0 away victory at Sunderland to maintain our 100% record this season in all competitions.

Following a goalless first half, David Raya was the hero as he made a superb save from Enzo Le Fee's penalty before Bruno Guimaraes' thunderbolt gave us the lead two minutes later - the Brazilian's first goal for the club.

Bukayo Saka's injury-time strike from a penalty secured the win as we moved to the top of the Premier League table.
